title: User guide
summary: ZIPSPEED measures internet speed and network health from real measurements. Values that are not measured or unavailable stay as -- instead of being fabricated.

sections.title: Getting started
items: Open Speed. In Settings, choose Quick or Standard and Single or Multi to match the amount of data and test style you want.
Tap GO to start. While a test is running the button becomes STOP and can cancel the current test.
Keep the app open until the test completes; leaving the app stops active measurement and foreground monitoring.
A -- value means there is no verified measurement yet or that value is unavailable.

sections.title: Main features
items: Speed shows measured Download, Upload, Ping (HTTP) and Jitter on the main screen, with loaded-latency details below.
Video gives a suitability estimate from measured download speed. It is not a real video-playback test.
Status and Map show network metadata reported by the measurement provider, such as public IP, edge code and country. They do not invent GPS or datacenter coordinates.
History stores completed measurement results locally on the device.
Monitor checks availability only while the app is open and records incident/recovery events after confirmation checks.
This test build has no Ads or Billing dependency, so Ad-free does not simulate a purchase or VIP entitlement.

sections.title: Permissions
items: Android permissions used by the current build are Internet and Network state.
The app does not request Android camera, microphone, contacts or location permission.
Country shown from network trace is approximate network metadata, not GPS.

sections.title: Errors and fixes
items: No healthy measurement server: confirm internet access and retry. ZIPSPEED requires a real successful server check and does not create a fake fallback result.
Timeout or test failed: try Quick first, keep the connection stable, then retry. Results are shown only after real measurement succeeds.
Unknown or -- means the source did not provide enough verified data; it is not replaced with a guessed value.

sections.title: Privacy and security
items: Measurement requests use HTTPS to the configured provider. The destination can see the public IP needed for network communication.
Server-reported country is treated as approximate location metadata; the app does not request GPS permission.
Measurement history keeps speed/latency results locally and does not store public IP, country or edge in History.
Android cleartext traffic is disabled. Open Privacy policy in Settings for the current disclosure.

sections.title: Support
items: Report reproducible problems through GitHub Issues for dachopol/ZIPSPEEDmain. Include the app version, Android version and steps to reproduce.
For measurement problems, include the time, Quick/Standard profile and Single/Multi mode when useful. Do not post passwords, keys or other secrets.

sections.title: Accessibility
items: Tabs and status areas use semantic roles and live-status labels; keyboard tab navigation supports arrow keys when a keyboard is available.
The layout adapts to phone, tablet, landscape and enlarged system text, and the app respects reduced-motion preference where supported.
If a screen reader does not announce a control correctly on your Android WebView version, report it through the support channel.
